IGLESIA Regional Director, DILG-Region IV-A 3/F Andenson Bldg. 1 National Highway Barangay Parian, Calamba City, Laguna Dear RD Iglesia: This pertains to your letter dated 23 November 2021 requesting for the Department's guidance regarding the conduct of Sangguniang Kabataan Federation Special Election. Per your letter, Mr. Brian B. Ballon, Municipal Local Government Operations Officer of Rosario, Batangas, would like to inquire if the conduct of federation special election has to follow the administrative and procedural aspect of conducting the regular federation election for only one position and only the officers shall nominate and vote from among themselves to fill the vacant position of Vice President. They are also in a query if they can conduct the federation special election for the Vice President as part of the SK Federation monthly meeting without the need to comply with the administrative and procedural aspect of the regular SK Federation election. Foremost, Section 21 (a) of Republic Act No. 10742, or the Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015 mandates the organization of the Panlalawigan, Panlungsod and Pambayang Pederasyon ng mga SK. In adherence to Section 21 (c) of RA No. 10742, the Department, together with the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) and the National Youth Commission (NYC) issued DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2017-01 dated June 23, 2017, which provides Guidelines on the Conduct of SK Pederasyon Election and Rules Governing Terms of Office, Suspension and Removal of all SK Pederasyon Officers. Further, Section 23(2) of the JMC mandates the Pederasyon at all levels to formulate and adopt their respective Intemal Rules of Procedures (IRP), which shall prescribe set of rules to serve as guidelines of the Pederasyon Officers and the Committees in the discharge of their official functions, duties and responsibilities, particularly on intemal orqanization, date, time and venue of regular or special session or meeting, parliamentary procedures, payment of pederasyon dues and such other rules and regulations that may be adopted by the pederasyon that are not contrary to existing laws, ordinances, and other government issuances. Notably, Ruie Viii, Section 41 (a)(1)(4) of the JMC states: "Section 41.FlLLlNG UP OF VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF THE PEDERASYON PRESIDENT: "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

PERMANENT VACANCY - In case the Pederasyon President voluntarily resiqns, dies is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, or has been absent without leave for more than three gonsecutive months, the Vice President of the concerned Pederasyon shall: (1) Automatically assume the office for the unexpired portion of the term; (4) Special election shall be held to elect the Vice President of the Pederasyon from among the other officers of the Pederasyon. Accordingly, it may be worthy to note that the Pederasyons at all levels are mandated to formulate and adopt their respective IRP, pursuant to Section 23 (2) of the JMC, which may provide, among others, rules and regulations internal to their organization. Finally, while RA No. 10742 does not provide for the organization of the National Federation of SK, the conduct of Special election as provided in Section 41 (a)(4) of the JMC, may be based on the IRP of the Pambayang Pederasyon ng mga SK of Rosario, Batangas, which shall serve as their Constitution and By-Laws that will govern their organization and may supplement or operationalize the existing provisions of the JMC. Be that as it may, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to the opinion of more competent authorities. Thank you. Very BY AUTHORITY OF T E SECRETARY: .
